identity.name: 5 Sports Street
identity.one_liner: An all-black colorway from the 2019 Seiko 5 Sports relaunch, representative of a wide range sharing the same case and hacking, hand-windable 4R36 movement.

narrative.story: The SRPD79 represents the 2019 relaunch of Seiko 5 Sports, which replaced the older Seiko 5 line's dressier day-date format with sport-diver styling and an upgraded caliber 4R36 — hacking and hand-windable, unlike the 7S-series calibers in older Seiko 5 watches. The SRPD79 runs an all-black colorway: hard-coated case, black dial, and a matching rotating bezel, one of dozens of dial and strap combinations Seiko released on the same case and movement.
narrative.collector_notes: The SRPD range spans many colorways on the same 42.5mm case and 4R36 movement; confirm the exact reference number before comparing prices, since colorway and strap material move resale value more than the underlying watch does.
